definitions.gloss: to exaggerate; to overstate; to embellish
definitions.explanation: To represent something as greater, more extreme, or more important than it actually is. Used for both intentional and unintentional exaggeration in speech, writing, or artistic expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{誇張|こちょう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誇張|こちょう}して⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: He always exaggerates when he tells stories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誇張|こちょう}→誇張：08680_kochou⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Without exaggeration, I think that movie is the best masterpiece of this year.

notes:
Used for making something sound bigger, better, worse, or more dramatic than reality. Applies to speech, writing, advertising, and artistic expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}→誇張：08680_kochou⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without exaggeration
- {誇張|こちょう}した⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: exaggerated expression
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}→誇張：08680_kochou⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: hyperbole (rhetorical device)
- ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誇張|こちょう}する: to greatly exaggerate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧: exaggerated; overdramatic — an adjective describing the quality of being exaggerated, rather than the act itself
- ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧: to embellish (colloquial) — casual slang for exaggerating a story; much more informal
- ⟦{過大|かだい}{評価|ひょうか}→過大評価：17706_kadaihyouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overestimate — focuses on rating something too highly rather than general exaggeration

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. More common in written language. In casual speech, ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧ or ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ are preferred.
